summary: Comprehensive test suite covering all core requirements (glob patterns, priority ordering, exclusion, error handling, CLI argument variants). Strong integration tests via GitHub Actions. Well-organized with good helper fixtures and clear test names. Gaps: `?` glob pattern untested, no tests for spaces/unicode in paths, no empty/duplicate path edge cases, no negative priorities. Assertion mechanisms (regex-based grepping) are somewhat brittle. Would reliably catch regressions in main features but might miss boundary conditions with special characters.
